title: 10/18 falsification checkpoint: replies 0 → redesign the Sales Motion at L4+ and execute it in the same fire
detail: Follow ops/2026-10/CHECKPOINT_1018.md. Count buyer replies on all channels (CrowdWorks + Coconala + any). If 0: the public-job application motion is falsified → redesign at L4+. FORBIDDEN: 'continue because the proposal count is low'. Compare all six (buyer_segment / offer / price / job_selection / channel / other_sales_motion — a motion other than applying to public jobs) with option, expected_effect, cost, evidence, score; choose; then in the SAME fire stop the replaced tasks (scan/proposal tasks), create the new tasks for the chosen motion (mac-local / founder), reallocate capacity, log a redesign event (--level L4|L5), update STATE hypotheses + priority_actions. Write checkpoint_1018 in the earliest 10/18 decision report (decision_check enforces). G2 deadline is 10/20 — choose motions that can produce a buyer response within days.
acceptance: earliest 2026-10-18 decision report passes decision_check with checkpoint_1018; stopped/new tasks exist; redesign event logged
